# Example of a quarto website with dashboard

Welcome 👋! 

This GitHub Pages based website is the solution of ["Bonus challenge 2: quarto website embedding the dashboard"](https://coding-club.inbo.be/sessions/20250224_static_dashboards.html#19). It shows how to combine dashboards with "standard" workflow webpages.

The website is composed of several pages:

- Homepage: the welcome page you are reading just now.
- A three paged **dashboard**: show graphs, leaflet map and data table using quarto syntax instead of flexdashboard.
- **About the Data**: the workflow in R to get the data used in the dashboard starting from th raw data.
